title.narrative: Increased capacities of employers' and workers' organizations to participate effectively in the development of social and labour policy

description.narrative: The International Labour Organization (ILO) is collaborating with the government to establish a Social Dialogue (SD) unit and council in Saudi Arabia. This will define the unit’s functions, activities, and staff responsibilities, and assist the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD) in staffing the unit. Training will be provided to enhance the unit’s capacity and familiarize them with social dialogue principles, and international labour conventions. Additionally, the ILO will support the development of a proposal for a SD council, detailing its structure and mandate, and will aid in drafting job descriptions for the council’s secretariat. The Ministry has shown interest in addressing policy gaps and considering the ratification of certain ILO conventions based on previous assessments and discussions. The ILO will also offer technical support to ensure Saudi laws align with international labour standards and help prepare for the ratification process. This initiative aims to foster effective participation in decision-making through structured social dialogue among tripartite stakeholders.
